In detail

Sussex Police recorded 429 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 10.0 per 1,000 residents, the 7th highest rate of Brighton and Hove's 21 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (31), vehicle crime (3), bicycle theft (3); the evening/night score by anti social behaviour (38), violent crime (26), public order (14). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Rottingdean Coastal safe?

Wandroz currently rates Rottingdean Coastal in Brighton and Hove as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Brighton and Hove during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Brighton and Hove at night. This rating is derived from Sussex Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Rottingdean Coastal safe at night?

At night, Rottingdean Coastal is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Brighton and Hove. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.
